metadata.summary: Alphabetical first slice of job_agent batch 8: project pins, systemd packaging, job application lifecycle (application.py, apply.py), candidate canonicalization (canonical.py), career package barrel, CV evidence/artifacts foundations (achievements, artifacts, cv_llm). 0 imports edges recorded (batchImportData empty); trust cross-file calls only where imports verified in source.

nodes.name: .python-version
nodes.description: Project Python version pin. Contains ``3.14``. Single line, no logic.
nodes.codeSummary: Repository pins the Python toolchain to 3.14.

nodes.name: docker/personal-ai.service
nodes.description: systemd unit for the Personal AI Gateway. Runs ``docker compose up`` in the docker directory and ``docker compose down`` on stop. Deploy packaging, no Python logic.
nodes.codeSummary: systemd service that starts/stops the Personal AI stack via docker compose.

nodes.name: job_agent/job_agent/__init__.py
nodes.description: Empty package marker, no code.

nodes.name: job_agent/job_agent/application.py
nodes.description: Job application lifecycle state machine. Defines the application stages, validates transitions (never skips stages, no invalid moves), detects terminal states, and normalizes company/title strings for stable identity.
nodes.codeSummary: Application lifecycle: stage validation, transition guards, terminal detection, company/title normalization.

nodes.name: ApplicationError
nodes.description: Base ValueError for application pipeline failures.

nodes.name: UnknownStageError
nodes.description: Raised when an application is referenced by an unknown stage identifier.

nodes.name: InvalidApplicationTransition
nodes.description: Raised when a stage transition is not allowed by the state machine.
nodes.codeSummary: ApplicationError subclass for invalid stage transitions.

nodes.name: Application
nodes.description: Stateful model of one job application: stage, timestamps, tracked normalized company and title. Guards stage changes through ``check_transition``.
nodes.codeSummary: One job application record with stage lifecycle enforcement.

nodes.name: valid_stages
nodes.description: Return the ordered list of all legal application stages.

nodes.name: is_valid_stage
nodes.description: True when ``stage`` is a known stage name.

nodes.name: check_transition
nodes.description: Validate a ``current -> target`` stage move; raises ApplicationError on unknown stages or illegal transitions.

nodes.name: is_terminal
nodes.description: True when the stage is a final, non-transitionable state.

nodes.name: _now
nodes.description: Current UTC timestamp, isoformat with seconds.

nodes.name: _parse_datetime
nodes.description: Parse a stored datetime string back to datetime.

nodes.name: is_valid_interview_stage
nodes.description: True when the value is a legal interview sub-stage.

nodes.name: normalize_company
nodes.description: Deterministic company-name normalization used for application identity.
nodes.codeSummary: Normalizes company names for stable identity.

nodes.name: normalize_job_title
nodes.description: Deterministic job-title normalization used for application identity.
nodes.codeSummary: Normalizes job titles for stable identity.

nodes.name: job_agent/job_agent/apply.py
nodes.description: Approval-gated application submission flow. Builds a human approval prompt from a job and CV/cover-letter paths, then executes the submission as an ApplicationRunner that only acts after approval.
nodes.codeSummary: Approval-gated application runner for job submissions.

nodes.name: approval_prompt
nodes.description: Compose the approval request text that a human must confirm before any submission happens.
nodes.codeSummary: Builds the consent prompt for the user.

nodes.name: ApplicationRunner
nodes.description: Executes an approved application using a CV path and optional cover letter; refuses to run without approval.
nodes.codeSummary: Runner that submits an approved application.

nodes.name: job_agent/job_agent/canonical.py
nodes.description: Canonical identity layer for job search. Normalizes companies, titles, locations into stable canonical forms; splits compound locations; builds dedupe keys and canonical URLs; dedupes candidate identifiers.
nodes.codeSummary: Canonicalization for company/title/location and dedupe keys.

nodes.name: _normalize
nodes.description: Casefold + strip a single text value.

nodes.name: normalize_company
nodes.description: Canonical form of a company name (stable across variants).

nodes.name: normalize_title
nodes.description: Canonical form of a job title.

nodes.name: normalize_location
nodes.description: Canonical form of a location string.

nodes.name: split_locations
nodes.description: Split a compound location string into individual locations.

nodes.name: _key
nodes.description: Join normalized company/title/location into a key fragment.

nodes.name: canonical_key
nodes.description: Build the canonical dedupe key ``company|title|location`` for a posting.

nodes.name: canonical_url
nodes.description: Normalize a job URL to a canonical identity form.

nodes.name: dedupe_candidates
nodes.description: Dedupe an iterable of candidate identifiers preserving order.

nodes.name: job_agent/job_agent/career/__init__.py
nodes.description: Barrel module re-exporting the career subpackage public API (artifacts, achievements, documents, evidence, fit, knowledge, llm, llm_log, mapping, positioning, positioning_plan, profile, reconcile, requirements, retrieval, semantic_mapping, user_artifacts). Only imports/__all__, no logic.
nodes.codeSummary: Career package barrel re-exporting all public career modules.

nodes.name: job_agent/job_agent/career/achievements.py
nodes.description: Deterministic achievement extraction from evidence claims. Flags claims whose text pattern signals a measurable achievement and caps them at a bounded set.
nodes.codeSummary: Extracts bounded, deterministic achievements from evidence.

nodes.name: Achievement
nodes.description: One extracted achievement: claim text, source evidence id and level.

nodes.name: _looks_achievement
nodes.description: Heuristic: True when a claim text looks like a measurable achievement.

nodes.name: derive_achievements
nodes.description: From evidence list, return ranked achievements capped at ``limit``. Reuses evidence ids, never invents facts.

nodes.name: job_agent/job_agent/career/artifacts.py
nodes.description: Career artifact domain model (CV artifacts): status enum, experience bullets, and the CVArtifact aggregate carrying document + bullets. Claims validated through ``career.validation``.
nodes.codeSummary: CVArtifact status/bullet models and validation hook.

nodes.name: ArtifactStatus
nodes.description: StrEnum lifecycle of an artifact (e.g. draft/approved lifecycle states).

nodes.name: Bullet
nodes.description: One experience bullet with evidence back-reference for a CV.

nodes.name: CVArtifact
nodes.description: Aggregate: a CV document product with status, bullets, and claim validation results.

nodes.name: job_agent/job_agent/career/cv_llm.py
nodes.description: CV tailoring via LLM. Schema-capped proposal generation (headline, summary, bullets) validated against an evidence allow-list; any failure degrades to ``None``. `OllamaCvClient` mirrors `llm.OllamaJsonClient` with ``think: false`` for reasoning models.

nodes.name: _is_transient
nodes.description: Classify httpx exceptions as transient for retry decisions.

nodes.name: CvLlmError
nodes.description: Raised when the model produced unusable tailoring output.

nodes.name: CvBullet
nodes.description: One length-capped CV bullet with optional evidence id reference.

nodes.name: CvProposal
nodes.description: Validated tailored CV proposal: headline, bullets, summary.

nodes.name: parse_tailoring
nodes.description: Parse + validate model output against the schema and evidence allow-list; raises CvLlmError on malformed output.
nodes.codeSummary: Validates raw model output into a CvProposal.

nodes.name: CvGenerationClient
nodes.description: Protocol for any CV generation backend; failures surface as ``None``.

nodes.name: OllamaCvClient
nodes.description: Ollama-backed tailoring client posting a JSON-schema ``format`` contract with retries and aggregate-only call logging.
nodes.codeSummary: Ollama CV client with retry + call log.
